sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Vishwadeep Patel
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
1.

The present application for grant of bail has been filed by the applicant, who is the husband of deceased and has been implicated in Case Crime No. 71 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Pahadi, District Chitrakoot, wherein allegation is that the marriage got solemnized with the applicant three years before the incident.
It is alleged that there was demand of dowry and the deceased has been done to death by administrating some poisonous substance to her.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case and that the allegation of demand of dowry is not substantiated.
Contention is that there are no injuries on the deceased.

It is further argued that the trial is likely to take sufficiently long and that the applicant undertakes that he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate Arjun Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8014558/
1 in the conduct of trial.

entities.text: Arjun Yadav vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 24.01.2024.

3. Learned AGA for the State opposes the prayer made for grant of bail by contending that the deceased died within seven years of her marriage and the death is unnatural i.e. on account of poisoning and that there is allegation with regard to demand of dowry.
4. In the facts of the case, we find that the deceased died within seven years of her marriage due to unnatural death and there is also allegation of demand of dowry.
In such circumstances, I am of the view that the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
5. Accordingly, the present bail application is rejected.
